mapper.sql: f.`id` AS id, f.`ptxmmc` AS ptxmmc, f.`crzdbh` AS crzdbh, f.`dkmc` AS dkmc, f.`ptsslb` AS ptsslb, f.`xzqh` AS xzqh, f.`xmfl` AS xmfl, f.`jsdw` AS jsdw
(f.`jsxx` IS NULL OR f.`jsxx` = '' OR f.`jsxx` NOT IN ('现状', '不涉及')) AND COALESCE(f.`ptxmmc`, '') NOT LIKE '%不涉及%'

ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`xjpfsfwc` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS landAcquisition, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`kypfsfwc` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS feasibility, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`csjgspfsfwc` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS preliminaryDesign, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`zjlsqk` = '未落实' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS fund, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`sfkg` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS notStarted, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`sfjg` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS notCompleted, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`sfyj` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS notHandedOver
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN THEN l.`id` END) AS landTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '市级项目' AND THEN l.`id` END) AS cityLandCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '区级项目' AND THEN l.`id` END) AS districtLandCount, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS facilityTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN AND f.`sfjg` = '是' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedFacilityCount FROM `t_land` l JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目') AND COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0'

SELECT l.`xzqh` AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN THEN l.`id` END) AS value, SUM(CASE WHEN AND f.`sfjg` = '是' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount FROM `t_land` l JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目') AND l.`xzqh` IS NOT NULL AND l.`xzqh` != '' AND COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0' GROUP BY l.`xzqh` HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC, l.`xzqh`

SELECT CONCAT(#{xmfl}, '-', l.`xzqh`) AS id, l.`xzqh` AS district,
FROM `t_land` l JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0' WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` = #{xmfl} AND l.`xzqh` IS NOT NULL AND l.`xzqh` != '' GROUP BY l.`xzqh` ORDER BY notHandedOver DESC, l.`xzqh`

SELECT l.`id` AS id, CONCAT(COALESCE(l.`xzqh`, ''), CASE WHEN l.`xzqh` IS NULL OR l.`xzqh` = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' END, COALESCE(NULLIF(l.`dkmc`, ''), l.`crzdbh`)) AS district,
FROM `t_land` l JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0' WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目') GROUP BY l.`id`, l.`xzqh`, l.`dkmc`, l.`crzdbh` ORDER BY notHandedOver DESC, district
